plugins.photosPermission: Myto Moto uses your photos for your profile picture, your bike, club covers and the photos of your documents.
plugins.cameraPermission: Myto Moto uses the camera to photograph your licence, registration, insurance and PUC. The photos stay on this phone.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Myto Moto records your ride's route while you ride.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Myto Moto records your ride's route in the background, so it keeps recording when your screen is locked or another app is open.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Myto Moto asks for Face ID before it shows a photo of your documents.

plugins.microphonePermission: Myto Moto records voice notes for your ride journal. They stay on this phone.
